purpose: Small standalone 3-D frozen-particle scalar pressure-Lstar diagnostic, not a JSphCpu force/complete-rate invocation, Cryer solver, boundary implementation or public3D admission. No XML/BI4/PART input, time integration, HG, field calibration, global matrix, eigenspectrum or FS repair.

geometry.cloud: At most19^3=6859 points, indices -9..9, X-fastest reference IDs. Lazy LOCAL C/rows only, never a full dense matrix.

geometry.full_support: Only reference(0,0,0) receiver. Halo covers receiver,neighbor C,and reverse-row supports. Reach4 is sufficient: closest four-cell axial gap .037m>2h.

arithmetic.kernel: Actual GetKernelWendland_Ctes(false,H)/GetKernelWendland_Fac(kw,float(H),float(rr2)); float awen/bwen/rad/qq/fac, double coordinates/moments/C/scalars. Support=float(2H),support2=support*support; Eta0 and double(float((.1H)^2)) separately.
arithmetic.C: Full3x3 inverse of -sum V*d tensor gradW, including cross terms; reject synthetic nonfinite/det<=1e-12 rather than substitute identity. No production CInverse/FS call.
arithmetic.operators: d=xi-xj,g=fac*d,b=V*Ci*g. Receiver uses Ci*g; real symC uses .5(Ci+Cj)*g. w=2V*d.cgrad/(r2+eta2); lp=sum w(fi-fj); lx=sum w*d; gp=sum V(fj-fi)Ci*g; Lstar=lp-gp.lx. Coefficient2 unchanged.
arithmetic.moments: a_ij=-w_ij-b_ij.lx_i. First=sum a_ij(xj-xi); second=.5sum a_ij(xj-xi)tensor(xj-xi). Record full Ci/Gx/second tensors, lx/first, second-I Frobenius error, real Cj/Cavg/variation.
arithmetic.precision_scope: Binary64 manufactured inputs, NOT production float pressure. Original absolute constant/affine-gradient1e-10 and affine-Lstar1e-8 gates test P1 arithmetic, not native-float affine accuracy. Local field scale and17-digit values recorded; no fitted limit.

fields: 14 fixed fields:7; X/Y/Z and1+3X-2Y+.5Z; .5alpha X^2/Y^2/Z^2; alpha XY/XZ/YZ; alpha(.5X^2+Y^2+1.5Z^2+.3XY-.2XZ+.4YZ); .5alpha|x|^2; cos(kX)cos(kY)cos(kZ). alpha2,k=pi/(12dp); analytic gradients/Laplacians. Quadratic/mixed/smooth errors descriptive; no exactness/convergence-order/physical gate.
isotropic_control: Separately labeled receiverC row is a common-Cj=Ci COUNTERFACTUAL, never substituted for real symC. Full-support regular paired/Eta0 response should be3alpha; coefficient3 counterfactual is4.5alpha. Four rows also report disorder/Eta2/real-symC/Cvariation; no3alpha claim for varying sphere Cavg and no quadratic pass threshold.
pair_and_volume: Local reciprocal V_i*a_ij vs V_j*a_ji defects max/sum/relative, plus raw-weight defect. Reverse rows use actual cloud. Selected-receiver sum V*Lstar vs V*exact is NOT whole-domain conservation or surface flux. No spectrum.

outputs.neighbors.csv: One real Ci-neighbor entry table per geometry/pattern/receiver, including d, rr2, actual float fac, Cj and Cavg; no eta/method duplication. At most12*728=8736 rows.
outputs.moments.csv: 48 rows=12receiver instances*2eta*2methods; full Ci/Gx/second tensors, lp coordinate defect, Lstar first moment, pair and C variation diagnostics.
outputs.fields.csv: 672 rows=48*14; lp/Lstar/exact/error, exact and corrected XYZ gradient, local field scale, independent coefficient-row action discrepancy.
outputs.isotropic_clone.csv: 4 explicitly counterfactual rows, no quadratic gate.
